description: This file contains unit tests for the MotionHandler class within an Android application. It tests handling motion activity and pedometer data, including permission checks, JSON parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: FakeMotionDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of the MotionDataSource interface used for testing MotionHandler. It provides configurable responses and simulates errors for activity and pedometer data.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests handling motion activity when permissions are not granted, expecting a permission required error.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests handling motion activity with invalid JSON input, expecting an invalid request error.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_returnsActivityPayload
methods.description: Tests that a valid motion activity payload is properly processed and returned.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer_mapsRangeUnsupportedError
methods.description: Tests handling of an unsupported range error from pedometer data, expecting an appropriate error response.
